fichas.title: Parking Facilities: Parking Spaces
fichas.summary: Guidance and illustrated layouts for integrating car parking spaces with adjacent walls, columns, kerbs, planting, pedestrian and cycle routes, and surrounding landscape. A space bordered by a pillar, wall, or column is widened on the relevant side; this exception does not apply to mechanical lifting platforms or automatic garages. A kerb defines the edge where a space faces a footpath, cycle way, or separation strip. Examples show accessible, comfortable, lowered, planted, block, and oblique parking arrangements. Planting and green roofs can provide shade and absorb dust.
uses: Integrate parking with pedestrian routes and planting
Reduce visual and environmental impacts through landscaping
